title: Chapter 1205
text:
Just as the two of them were surprised, the six Beyond Grade As approached and surrounded them.

The one at the front seemed to be the leader, and he spoke loudly. However, neither Han Xiao nor Kasuyi understood what he was saying. The other party was using an unfamiliar language that was not in the database of the universal translation device.

Kasuyi narrowed his eyes, released his psychic energy to communicate, and pulled Han Xiao into the chat channel.

Seeing this scene, the leader on the other side was stunned for a moment, seeming to feel puzzled. Then, he received the mental communication. As soon as it connected, he immediately questioned,

"Who are you? Where are you from? Don't you understand the universal language? "

"Where is this?" Kasuyi asked.

"The capital of Emperor Tuo Province, a colonial planet under the jurisdiction of the Corpus Civilization. I'm the captain of the Emperor Tuo Guardians, Farlite. Please explain your origins and identity immediately. Why did you appear above the city? Answer the question! "

Hearing this, Han Xiao and Kasuyi looked at each other and felt the confusion of the other through the mental connection.

Corpus Civilization? They had never heard of it. Looking at the history of the exploration era, there seemed to be no records. Could this be a civilization born in the secondary dimensions and had never appeared in the main universe? Although they did not know what their technological level was, with six Beyond Grade As overseeing it, they would definitely have a place in the main universe.

Seeing that the two of them did not respond, Farlite's tone became heavier.

"This is the period of martial law in the entire universe. You have violated the ban of the Celestial Star Alliance, visiting the colonial planets of other civilizations without permission and casually displaying your strength. According to the relevant laws, you must immediately disarm, seal your source energy, and accept our investigation. Otherwise, we will take coercive measures!"

They could understand every word of these words, but when they were connected together, the two of them were a little confused.

Martial law in the entire universe? Celestial Star Alliance? Source energy? What the hell is all of this?

Although they did not understand the meaning of these names, the other party's meaning was clear. It was nothing more than asking them to give up resistance. In this unfamiliar environment, the two of them naturally could not give up on self-preservation and be captured.

Kasuyi still wanted to ask for more information, but seeing that the two of them were indifferent, Farlite's expression darkened. He did not waste any more time and directly attacked.

Boom!

His aura suddenly exploded, and with a flash of rainbow light, Farlite appeared in front of Kasuyi as if he had teleported. His fist rumbled and shook the air, producing a thunderous sound.

"You dare to attack me?"

Kasuyi frowned. His speed was even faster. He reached out and placed his hand on the side of Fati's fist. His psychic power flowed, and his body tilted slightly. Then, he casually pushed aside the vigorous Martial Dao flames spurting out of Fati's fist and turned into a beam of light that disappeared into the horizon.

Then, his movements changed slightly, and a light forward elbow strike landed on Farlite's chest. The highly condensed psychic power was like a needle, pouring into the opponent's body through the area of impact without any wastage.

Bang!!

Due to the explosive force, Farlite was unable to control his body and was sent flying backwards at a speed several times faster than before. He crashed through several tall buildings, leaving behind a large hole that penetrated from the front to the back as he disappeared into the distance.

Han Xiao could not help but raise his eyebrows. "Yo, you're also a martial artist who can fight hand-to-hand."

"Don't look down on me. I fought my way out of the Void Dimension after all. Close combat is also my forte."

Kasuyi swung his arm, his tone casual.

Although he was used to squandering the infinite mana provided by the Void Dimension, before he established the Dimensional Link, his fighting style had always been very meticulous. Under the premise of not wasting energy, he would cause the greatest damage. As a Void Creature who had been in the Void Dimension since young, close combat was not his weakness.

Furthermore, he was a peak Beyond Grade A after all. Just based on his basic attributes, he could compete with an ordinary Beyond Grade A Pugilist, not to mention that he also had the dual attributes of Psychic and Physical Energy.

The other five Beyond Grade As seemed to be shocked and let out the same exclamation. Han Xiao did not know what they were talking about. The next moment, the five of them rushed up and launched a siege.

The various weapons protruding from the city on the ground also opened fire. Boom boom boom boom! It was as if fireworks had lit up all over the ground. Densely-Packed energy rays soared into the sky, and countless light chains lashed out toward the two of them.

"Oh, these people are so irritable, fighting right above the city. Aren't they afraid that we'll blow up their balls?"

Han Xiao complained. With a wave of his hand, Mechanical Force shot out, and the surrounding mechanical troops quickly returned fire, blocking the attacks of the weapons on the ground while tangling with the five Beyond Grade As.

The mechanical troops that were fighting the Space Lice outside the secondary dimension were all brought in by Han Xiao. Although the secondary dimensional army box and the Dimension Factory could not be opened at this time, and he could not summon more troops, Han Technician was not nervous at all.

The weapons of Mechanics were all built by themselves, so they could not use the inventory. Thus, they could just use the materials on the ground to make whatever they lacked. There was nothing to panic about.

Having a strong hands-on ability, this was how confident he was!

Of the six opponents, two were Pugilists, one was a Mage, and three were Psychics. They were all ordinary Beyond Grade As with Energy Ranks below 52000 Ona. As soon as the two sides clashed, the five Beyond Grade As immediately fell into a disadvantage. Even if Farlite hurried back to the battlefield, he could not reverse the situation and could only bitterly hold on.

With the attribute bonus of the level 340 Promotion, coupled with the explosive output of [Legendary Battle Technique] and [Fearless Heart], ordinary Beyond Grade As would be courting death if they tried to take the attacks head-on. Furthermore, there was another peak Beyond Grade A Kasuyi beside him. Facing these ordinary life forms, his psychic power could finally display its full lethality. With the two of them working together, it was really easy to beat up six ordinary Beyond Grade As.

However, there were at least six of them. Although they were not a match for Han Xiao and Kasuyi, it would not be a problem for them to hold on for a while. Furthermore, the two of them did not know what was going on here and did not intend to kill anyone for the time being.

While using psychic needles to cause the opponents to bleed, Kasuyi communicated with Han Xiao through the psychic channel.

"Black Star, we're not in our strongest state right now. There's still a peak Beyond Grade A outside the secondary dimension. If he joins the battle, the situation will not be good. There's no need for us to continue fighting. Let's leave this place first and ask for more information."

"That's what I think too. Let me get rid of them."

Han Xiao nodded. He was very concerned about the information revealed by these people. Currently, he only wanted to figure out the current situation.

With a thought, his Mechanical Force pulled all the mechanical soldiers together and gathered them together.

Clank!

The all-powerful Mechanical Deity descended once again. It extended its arm and grabbed Kasuyi, sucking him into the body. Then, its thrusters fired, and its huge body rose into the air, quickly approaching outer space.

Farlite shouted, as if telling the two of them not to run. He led the five Beyond Grade As and chased after them. Pugilist flames, psychic attacks, and magical waves continuously bombarded the Mechanical Deity, but they were all blocked by the honeycomb structure psionic shield of the Emperor's Robe.

"Still chasing? These people really don't know what's going on. They lack love. "

Han Xiao looked down and helplessly raised the Celestial Punishment Edge. The surging psionic energy followed the path of the Getta Hadoken and condensed on the edge of the blade. He then slashed down with the blade, creating a solid blade glow.

Screech!

The dark blue blade glow tore the sky apart, and the sound of space cracking could be heard.

The power of this blade caused the expressions of Farlite and the others to change drastically. They hurriedly used their strongest defensive means to collide with the blade glow.

Rumble!!

Violent energy shockwaves spread out, dispersing the nearby atmosphere and turning it into an area without clouds.

"Ah!"

The screams quickly faded away. Farlite and the others were slashed down and smashed into the ground. A large number of tall buildings collapsed. Looking down from outer space, it was as if six mushroom clouds made of dust had grown on the surface of the earth.

"You didn't kill them, did you?" Kasuyi was worried.

"I haven't used any strength yet. How can such an attack kill them?" Han Xiao did not care.

Kasuyi rolled his eyes.

He finally understood what was going on. Black Star had clearly improved again, but he was purposely hiding it here. Did he think that he was blind?

The Mechanical Deity turned around and flew across the starry sky, quickly leaving this planet.

At this time, Farlite and the others crawled out of the ruins on the ground, all of them injured. Seeing the group of Mechanical Deities disappear from their sight, they could not help but feel a lingering fear.

That slash just now made them feel an extremely terrifying threat to their lives, and they almost thought they were going to die.

The few of them looked around and saw that the galactic city they were guarding was already in a mess. Everyone could not help but feel a burst of anger.

"What do we do now?" someone asked.

"Those two are 'Supreme' experts. They're not people we can deal with," Farlite said angrily. Farlite angrily said, "The appearance of these two is too strange. I suspect that they will interfere with the world reboot plan. Immediately report to the Celestial Star Alliance Superpower Security Department and ask them to send a hunting team and issue a universal warrant!"

…

Secondary dimensions were strange and had their own rules of operation. However, this secondary dimension's environment was extremely similar to the main universe's. It was also full of stars, seemingly endless. Even in the secondary dimension world, this was an extremely rare situation.

Although this dimension was a cosmic environment, the star map of the main universe was not applicable here. After Han Xiao controlled the Mechanical Deity to leave the planet, he used the parts and materials of the mechanical soldiers to build an astronomical observatory. He drew a star map of the surroundings on the spot and found a meteorite belt, so he made a detour and temporarily stopped there.

Very soon, the meteorite belt appeared in front of him. Han Xiao disassembled the Mechanical Deity and restored the mechanical army to guard the surroundings. He then boarded one of the meteorites with Kasuyi to discuss the next countermeasures.

"… This secondary dimension is ridiculously large. I don't know where the end is. I can't find the spatial wall of the dimension. What about you?" Kasuyi frowned.

"Same for me. This is just like a normal universe." Han Xiao spread his hands.

Kasuyi paced and pondered. "Could it be that this secondary dimension is actually a giant wormhole that transferred us to an unexplored universe not controlled by the three Universal Civilizations? Could it be that what we met just now was a civilization in another corner of the universe?"

"I don't think so." Han Xiao shook his head. "The connection to the Void Dimension is broken, and my Dimension Factory can't be opened. This characteristic doesn't seem like we've returned to the main universe."

"That's true …" Kasuyi suddenly thought of something. "Your Dimension Factory can't be opened? Then you won't be able to take out the King mechanical suit. Won't we be trapped here? "

"You don't have to worry about that." Han Xiao picked up the compressed orb necklace on his neck, then showed his bracelet and smiled. "I'm used to carrying a spare King mechanical suit with me. There are a few sets here, and they can all be teleported to the outside world."

Devices such as the spacetime stabilization anchor could restrain the secondary dimensional army box, so he naturally would not be unprepared. Some of the more crucial devices would be made into compressed orbs and carried on his body.

"Then I'm relieved." Kasuyi heaved a sigh of relief. It was not that he wanted to leave now, but he was worried that there was no way out. Seeing how reliable Han Xiao was, he felt a lot more at ease.

"By the way, this secondary dimension seems to be completely isolated from the outside world. I can't contact my main artificial intelligence through the quantum network," Han Xiao said.

Philip's mainframe was in the base. Ever since entering this secondary dimension, the connection had been cut off. Han Xiao could not connect to the quantum network of the explored universe, so he could only switch to a backup sub-body of Philip that he carried with him and use it as a local network. At the same time, he was temporarily unable to lock onto the Lord's Avatar in the outside world and could not use [Lord's Descent] to return his consciousness to the outside world.

Now that he had opened the quantum network, he could only connect to the quantum network in this secondary dimension. He had tried it during the battle earlier and found that the basic coding language of the quantum network in this dimension was different from the main universe. Just like the Virtual Mutiny Virus, he had to decipher the basic coding first before he could use his various virtual methods.

"By the way, how's your sensing of the God's Trait Transformation opportunity?" Han Xiao asked curiously.

Kasuyi helplessly said, "It's still there, but it's become blurry. The target of my sensing is the entire space, and there's no exact direction."

"That's not good. Without your sensing guidance, how are we going to find it in such a huge secondary dimension?"

Han Xiao shook his head.

If the sensing was still there, it would be easy. They could just follow the guidance and get the opportunity, and then use the King to escape. But now that there was no direction, it was much more troublesome.

"We can only look for it slowly." Kasuyi looked at Han Xiao hopefully. "You don't have anything else to do, right?"

"I don't have anything to do. I can accompany you for a while, but if we don't find it after a long time, I can only leave first."

Han Xiao shrugged.

He did not have to worry about the players' Pro League, and he had a lot of time. Not only did he plan to complete Kasuyi's mission, but he also planned to obtain some technology here. Back then, the Kunde Race's Spacetime Splicing Technology was very useful. The civilization in this secondary dimension might have some black technology.

By the way, speaking of the players …

Han Xiaoxin opened the forums and found that the functions were normal. He could still see the posts of the players.

Currently, all kinds of external communication had failed, and the forums had become the only channel to receive information from the outside world. It was reliable.

Kasuyi paced back and forth and pondered. "Black Star, what's your plan next?"

Han Xiao glanced at him, thought for a while, and said, "We don't know much about this secondary dimension yet.

"We still don't know the situation of this secondary dimension. I suggest that we treat it as another universe. We are outsiders, and our priority is to collect information.

How about this? Give me some time to decipher the compiled language of the quantum network of this space, then invade the network to collect information … Hmm, before that, we need a temporary star map. I'll just draw it, and the astronomical observatory can solve this problem.

Also, the danger level of this space is unknown. I have to expand the current mechanical army, find some resource planets to build temporary strongholds, make engineering equipment to collect various materials, and build a new assembly line for explosive troops … "

Han Xiao explained the plan in detail, and everything was arranged in an orderly manner.

Since the Dimension Factory was frozen, he planned to open a base in this secondary dimension and duplicate a military factory to solve the combat, logistics, detection, concealment, and so on simultaneously.

After listening for a long time, Kasuyi could not help but ask, "Then, what do I need to do?"

"You …" Han Xiao pinched his chin and sized Kasuyi up. After pondering for a few seconds, he said with certainty, "Just don't cause trouble."

Hearing this, Kasuyi could not help but smile bitterly.

It was no wonder that among the five Super classes, the advanced civilizations were most afraid of the Mechanic class. This was a mobile interstellar war system!

He could not help but be glad that he had brought along a Mechanic this time. If he had brought along a Pugilist who only knew how to beat people, they could only stare at each other.

The Pugilist class was indeed weak!

…

In a metal mechanical room, a man with tubes all over his body slowly opened his eyes. He had two pairs of green eyes, one big and one small, symmetrically distributed on his left and right sides. A vertical scar ran across the left side of his face, cutting open two eyeballs. Half of his face was blind.

His breathing was sticky like an old bellows. After a while, a low murmur sounded in the room, vague and unclear.

"Finally, another outsider has come … This time, it's best if the person is of some use …"
